__broaden__.coniunx: coniūnx, coniugis (m./f.) — spouse; wife, husband (nom. sg.) · also voc. sg., O husband (miserrime coniunx)
__broaden__.flammae: flamma, -ae (f.) — flame, fire (nom. pl.) · also gen. sg. (ultricis flammae, of the avenging fire)
__broaden__.ingentibus: ingēns, ingentis — huge, mighty, great (f. abl./dat. pl.) · also n. abl. pl. (tectis ingentibus, the huge halls)
